title: shrink_result
description: repro/shrink.json: what came of reducing a failing attempt to the shortest replay that still fails the same way.

signature.description: The failure signature the replays had to keep.

status.description: complete: no single decision can be removed, and the trace verified. partial: a budget ran out, and this is the best trace that verified. unverified: the smallest trace didn't reproduce every time, so this is the smallest that did, or the original.

confirm.description: How often the smallest trace found reproduced when it was verified. With status unverified, that trace may not be the one kept.

model_calls.description: Replays reuse recorded decisions, so this is 0 unless something is wrong.

probe_errors.description: Replays that couldn't run at all. Many of these mean the rate says little about the failure.

ticks.description: Its duration in game ticks: what the recorded decisions took.
